title: The Case of the Missing Lid
skyStory: The moon begins to wane, ninety-six percent and still in fussy Virgo, counting every container in the cosmic cupboard. There are forty-one containers. There are thirty-eight lids. Virgo is beside itself. Saturn launches a formal inquiry. Mars suggests just using a plate on top, and the whole sky gasps in horror. The inquiry runs well past midnight.

reading: A small mystery will consume a ridiculous amount of your attention today. A lid, a key, a charging cable that was right here five minutes ago. You will search with the intensity of a detective in a rainstorm, muttering theories under your breath.

Here is the secret: it is under something blue. The Virgo moon will not tell you more than that. While you search, notice how much energy you give to small problems, and how good it feels when you finally solve one. The [[Page of Pentacles]] is cheering. Victory is victory, however tiny the lid.
joel.mission: When you find something you lost today, announce the discovery like a news anchor breaking a story.
joel.omen: Something blue sitting on top of something else. Look under it, because a small mystery is about to end.
joel.stoneWhy: sharp eyes for the great search
joel.elementWhy: clear the cobwebs, find the lid

reading: The Wood Rat finds things. That is simply a fact. Today someone near you will lose something, and you will spot it within a minute, sitting in plain sight, being smug about it. They will call you a genius. Accept the title.

Later, you will notice a mismatch somewhere: a calendar that says the wrong day, a sock that is not quite the same shade as its partner. Leave one mismatch alone, on purpose. Virgo will twitch. Saturn will understand. Some things are more charming slightly wrong, and you know exactly which ones.
nancy.mission: Help someone find a lost thing today, then refuse to explain how you knew where it was.
nancy.omen: A lid that does not fit its container. It means a small rule can be broken without consequence.
nancy.elementWhy: go with the flow of mysteries

together.text: Each of you hides one small object somewhere in your home in plain sight, then describes the hiding spot to the other in a riddle. The other gets three guesses. Whoever stumps the other wins the title of Supreme Finder for the week.

game.intro: A lid has gone missing and Saturn suspects everyone. Answer fast so you look innocent.
